title: Cut consumers over to the new generated pack model; remove stale overlay read-paths
description:
Compatibility/cutover bead (review-requested). The thaw changes the generated pack SCHEMA (typed progression rows, structured ASIs/languages/spellcasting/equipment, tableRefs, proficiencyNotes, typed choices). Update every consumer to read the new model and ensure NO stale overlay/prose read-path silently masks a pack deficiency:
  - rulesPackResolver and the rules-pack loading/validation surface
  - character creation (level-1 derivation)
  - level-up / progression engine (consume typed advancement entries from .2)
  - audit tooling that reads pack records
  - any CLI path that previously consulted packages/core/src/character/srd*.ts overlays
Make overlay reads fail-loud or removed rather than fall back to prose, so the smoke tests (.12) and gates (.11) actually exercise pack data. Pairs with .15 (overlay retirement): this bead severs runtime READS; .15 converts the constants to oracle tests. Coordinate schema-version bump / migration if the resolver pins a pack schema version.
notes:
ABSORBED INTO eshyra-o9bd.2 (2026-06-28): the 'replace now' decision means .2 itself cuts consumers (resolver + level-up engine + tests) over to progression[].advancement[] and removes the old marker/null read-paths. No separate cutover remains. Will close as absorbed when .2 lands; reopen only if a concrete stale read-path is found later.
Done as part of PR #353 (eshyra-o9bd.2): resolver + level-up engine + .11 gate cut over to progression[].advancement[]; old marker/null read-paths removed. No stale read-path remains. Closing as absorbed.
